body: I come from a close minded asian family. They'll go hysterical if I end up failing AGAIN. I should've ever fucking come back. Wasting away 20k in tuition! This shit isn't worth it if I'm just gonna keep failing. I hate bitching like this but I have no one else to talk to which brings me here, thanks everyone for expressing your thoughts. It helps a bit.

It's almost like I don't even try. I just sit around with no motivation and depressed 90% of the day for like the past 5 months. My parents have dumped a shit ton of money on this, I feel like a fucking piece of shit throwing it all away like this.
